public_rationale: The factual part holds. In a March 2024 Wall Street Journal interview, CTO Mira Murati was asked whether Sora used YouTube videos. She said 'I'm actually not sure about that' and would not go further. In May 2024 COO Brad Lightcap was asked at a Bloomberg event to 'clear up once and for all' whether Sora was trained on YouTube data. He gave a long answer that did not say yes or no. Two senior executives dodging a direct question fits 'evasive'. His guess that OpenAI did train on YouTube was openly hedged and is not scored. No source found confirms or denies it.
limitations: 'Incredibly' is a characterization; only the non-answers are verified.
The guess about actual training data is not scored.
